stages.ix_title: Which sentence has the same meaning?

prompt.en: Which sentence has the same meaning?

what_to_do.en: Tap the sentence that means the same.

stages.choice_rule: Write four short kid sentences. Exactly one restates the stem with a Grade 2 synonym or paraphrase. The other three must be an antonym rewrite, a different subject or object, and a near-miss that keeps most words. Never repeat the stem as a choice. One tap and one right answer.

choices: The kids spoke in a loud way.
The kids spoke in a quiet way.

gold_items.stem: The bird flew above the tree.
choices: The bird flew over the tree.
The bird flew under the tree.
The bird flew near the tree.
The duck flew above the tree.

roots: Every item has four original sentences and one right answer. Never reuse the stem wording as a choice.
The right choice must restate the stem with a clear Grade 2 synonym or a short paraphrase, not extra facts.
Always include one antonym rewrite that flips a key word to its opposite.
Always include one choice that changes the person, pet, or thing.
Always include one near-miss that keeps most words but changes time, place, manner, or a close verb.
Keep every stem and choice in kid world: school, home, food, pets, play, family, or weather. No brands.
Use two-syllable words and Grade 2 pairs such as begin/start, close/shut, also/too, above/over, and quietly/in a quiet way.
Wrong choices must still be grammatical whole-word sentences, never isolated sounds or picture descriptions.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of four to six words. One obvious synonym swap such as little/small, happy/glad, or large/big. Distractors are a clear opposite or a different animal or thing.
tier_rules.2: Grade-level stems with two-syllable words. Use pairs like close/shut, neat/tidy, or begin/start. Distractors flip to an opposite, change the object, or change the time.
tier_rules.3: Near-miss paraphrases. Use manner restatements, above/over versus under/near, or a close subject swap. Keep stems kid-short and still one right answer.

little_small.en: Little and small mean the same thing.

happy_glad.en: Happy and glad mean the same thing.

large_big.en: Large and big mean the same thing.

close_shut.en: Close and shut mean the same thing.

neat_tidy.en: Neat and tidy mean the same thing.

begin_start.en: Begin and start mean the same thing.

quietly_quiet.en: Quietly means in a quiet way.

above_over.en: Above and over can mean the same thing.
above_over.ko: above와 over는 같은 뜻으로 쓰일 수 있습니다.

same_meaning.en: The right sentence says the same idea with other words.
same_meaning.ko: 정답 문장은 다른 말로 같은 뜻을 말합니다.

opposite.en: That sentence says the opposite, not the same.
opposite.ko: 그 문장은 같은 뜻이 아니라 반대입니다.

other_thing.en: That sentence is about a different person or thing.
other_thing.ko: 그 문장은 다른 사람이나 다른 것에 대한 말입니다.

close_not_same.en: Those words are close, but the meaning is not the same.
close_not_same.ko: 그 말들은 비슷하지만 뜻이 같지는 않습니다.
